issues.explanation: Chapter 54 already says Liu Bei and Sun Shangxiang enter the bridal chamber on their wedding night, while Chapter 55 says they subsequently marry after the weapons are removed, making the marriage occur twice.
issues.suggested_fix: Change Chapter 55 to say they complete the wedding ceremony or begin married life after the weapons are removed, or revise Chapter 54 so it only says Liu Bei enters the bridal chamber and discovers the armed attendants.
